annotations.title: Which Shopify plan and billing fit your sales

description: Works out which Shopify plan (Basic, Grow, Advanced) costs least at a store's card sales: each plan's price plus the card fees that change with the plan (or Shopify's third-party fee on sales through another processor), the card sales above which each move up pays for itself, on monthly and yearly billing, and what yearly billing takes off the price. It fits a seller who asks whether to upgrade or downgrade their Shopify plan, whether yearly billing is worth it, or why a bigger plan costs them more. Takes monthly card sales (US dollars), the current plan, billing and processor; with both processors, the share Shopify Payments handles. Returns every plan's cost, the cheapest plan on the current billing and on either billing, the break-even sales, and the yearly-billing difference, with the dated Shopify rates and sources. A move's value holds at these sales; below the break-even the bigger plan costs more. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

billing.description: How the plan is paid now.

currentPlan.description: The store's plan (Settings > Plan). Plus is priced per store and Starter's figures aren't on Shopify's pricing page, so neither is compared here.

monthlyCardSales.description: Online card sales a month, US dollars (order totals with shipping): what the card fees are charged on.

premiumCardShare.description: Share of card sales on premium cards (Amex, business cards), which pay a higher rate on every plan. Default 0.

processor.description: How card payments arrive (Settings > Payments): shopify-payments, another (Stripe, Square and others; Shopify then adds its third-party fee), or both.

shopifyPaymentsShare.description: With both: the share of sales Shopify Payments handles, a fraction. Left out: half, flagged.

name: sellerprofit_shopify_plan_fit

assumedNoPremium.description: True when premiumCardShare was left out and some sales go through Shopify Payments: none were counted as premium cards; the seller's own share would change the answer.

breakEvens.description: Price gap ÷ rate gap, for each move up, on both billings.

sales.description: Card sales a month above which `to` costs less than `from`, US dollars; null when `to` has no lower rate.

cheapest.description: The cheapest plan on the store's current billing.

lessThanCurrent.description: Current plan's cost − this plan's, a month, on the current billing, US dollars (0 when the current plan is cheapest).

cheapestAnyBilling.description: The cheapest plan and billing together, against the current plan on its current billing.

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

plans.description: Each plan's cost at these sales. Fees the same on every plan (the 30¢, currency, the other processor's own fee) drop out.

monthlyBilling.description: Plan price + the plan-dependent card or third-party fees a month at these sales, on monthly billing, US dollars.

rate.description: The plan-dependent rate on these sales: the card rate on Shopify Payments' share, Shopify's third-party fee on the rest.

yearlyBilling.description: The same on yearly billing (price per month).

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which figures are estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest depend on the size and stock Amazon measures). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

sameAsCheapest.description: Other plans that cost the same as the cheapest to the cent, on the current billing (empty when none do).

shareIsDefault.description: True when the split is the default half, which the seller's own split would replace.

shopifyPaymentsShare.description: The share Shopify Payments handles: 1, 0, or the split.

yearlyBilling.description: What yearly billing takes off the price: the current plan first, then the cheapest plan when it differs.

title: Which Shopify plan and billing fit your sales
